channel.title: DailyBite — Daily Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu
item.description: Choose from 3-piece Signature Chicken, 3-piece Tenders, a Chicken Sandwich, or 8-piece Butterfly Shrimp for just $5; order in-store, online, or in the app. (Through August 30, 2026)

item.title: Arby's: Meat & 3 Box for $7.99
item.description: Get a Classic Roast Beef or Crispy Chicken sandwich, small fry, 2-piece Mozzarella Sticks, 1-piece Peach Cobbler Roll, and a small drink for $7.99. (Limited time)

item.title: Arby's: $1.99 Sliders
item.description: Get Arby's sliders for only $1.99 each, available in-store and via the app for a limited time. (Limited time)

item.title: Sonic: $1.99 Everyday Value Menu
item.description: Score a Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger, Chicken Wrap, and more items for just $1.99 each every day, no app required. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me Meal at $10.99
item.description: Get a drink, appetizer, and a full entree for $10.99 at Chili's; available for dine-in at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Pizza Hut: $10 Medium 1-Topping Stuffed Crust
item.description: Order a medium 1-topping Stuffed Crust pizza for just $10 via the Throwback Value Menu at Pizza Hut; available for carryout. (Ongoing)

item.title: KFC: $7 Box Feast
item.description: Get a filling KFC Box Feast for $7; check the app or website for your local Box Feast options. (Limited time)

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Classic Frosty
item.description: Grab a small Classic Frosty for only $1 at participating Wendy's in-restaurant, drive-thru, in the app, or on Wendys.com. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-07
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
